subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & demo deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Ellora Rao <ellora@carepath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 22:10:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & demo deep dive

Hi Ellora —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same context:  
- Primary goal: reduce clinician note time and automate coding suggestions (entity extraction + summarization).
- Key constraints: sub-200ms median token latency for UI flows, PHI-protected data (on-prem / VPC option), and strict retention rules (18 months).
- Success signals you called out: extraction precision for ICD-like entities, summary brevity/accuracy, and no PII leakage in outputs.

Next step: run an evaluation/kickoff where we (1) run a short demo of the integration surface, (2) align on trial success criteria and metrics, and (3) plan the prompt/eval set and tech deep dive for integration. Proposed 60-minute slots next week (pick one):
- Mon Mar 22 — 14:00-15:00 PT
- Tue Mar 23 — 09:00-10:00 PT
- Wed Mar 24 — 11:00-12:00 PT

Agenda (30–40 min tech + 15–20 min success criteria & ops):
1) 15-min live demo showing our low-latency streaming and example prompt set for note summarization
2) 20-min tech deep dive (auth, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs) with CS/infra
3) 15-min success criteria and mutual action plan (data prep, metrics, timeline)

I've attached a lightweight trial charter and a first-pass prompt pack to speed the discussion. If you confirm a slot, we’ll send a calendar invite and add our security lead for the SSO/KMS conversation if you’d like.

Attachments: trial-charter-CPAI.pdf (1 page summary), carepath_prompt_pack_v1.md (sample prompts & eval cases)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Ellora Rao <ellora@carepath.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 23:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & demo deep dive

Thanks — great summary, Alex. Tue Mar 23 09:00-10:00 PT works best for our team. Please include Raj Patel (security) on the invite so we can cover SSO and data handling (raj@carepath.ai).

A few notes for the agenda:  
- We’d like the demo to show a short EHR->summary workflow (example FHIR bundle preferred).
- For success criteria, we’ll be tracking: entity extraction F1 on our baseline set, time-to-first-summary in the UI, and any obvious hallucination cases.
- Please flag any prework we should complete—sample data, schema, or a simple API key for testing.

If you can send the invite and a shared Drive link for the prompt pack, I’ll get Raj and our PM to confirm.

Best,
Ellora Rao
Head of Clinical Product, CarePath AI
ellora@carepath.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellora Rao <ellora@carepath.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Mar 2027 03:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule evaluation kickoff & demo deep dive

Alex / Marissa —

I can own the evaluation playbook and run the tech deep dive on Tue. A couple of quick internal asks so we’re lined up for the kickoff:  
- Proposed trial success metrics (draft):
  * Entity extraction: target F1 >= 0.88 on their baseline set after prompt tuning
  * Summary latency: median end-to-end <= 400ms in our hosted demo (we’ll show optimizations to get to 200ms in Dedicated)
  * Safety: zero high-severity PHI leakage in a 1k-sample audit during pilot
- Prework requested from CarePath: one de-identified FHIR bundle sample (or a small synthetic export), and confirmation on whether they prefer SSO via SAML or OIDC for the trial environment.

I’ll bring a minimal runbook, sample evaluation script, and a short prompt-tuning checklist. If Ellora adds Raj to the invite that’s perfect; I’ll cover the KMS/SSO talking points.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success (Trials), Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Ellora Rao <ellora@carepath.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@carepath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 17:22:00 +0000
Subject: Confirmed: CarePath AI — evaluation kickoff (Tue Mar 23 09:00 PT)

Thanks — confirmed for Tue Mar 23, 09:00-10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=carepath-kickoff

Quick logistics & prework: 
- Please upload one de-identified FHIR bundle (or synthetic sample) to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example (folder includes the prompt pack & trial charter).
- Raj: noted on SSO — we support both SAML and OIDC; Ben will cover the KMS/SSO setup and what we need for a short smoke test.
- Pre-reading: trial-charter-CPAI.pdf and carepath_prompt_pack_v1.md (linked in Drive).

Meeting agenda (final):
1) 10-min demo: EHR -> summarization (live example)
2) 25-min tech deep dive: auth, API, KV cache behavior, latency tuning
3) 20-min success criteria & mutual action plan: metrics, roles, timeline, data handoff
4) 5-min next steps & calendaring for trial sprint

If anyone needs a different slot, flag now and we’ll reshuffle — otherwise see you Tue.

Best,
Alex Martinez
